subject: Thanks for signing up — pick a time for a quick Redwood demo
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Iza Novak <iza@olivetech.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — pick a time for a quick Redwood demo

Hi Iza —

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood demo! I wanted to send over a few quick options so you can pick whatever works best for your team. Our self-serve flow captured your interest and auto-sent a confirmation, but I (Logan) will be your SDR point-of-contact if you want a live walk-through.

Quick notes: 
- Pick a slot on our scheduling page: https://cal.redwood.com/olivetech/meet (times will show in your browser timezone).
- If you need a specific timezone shown in the booking UI, there’s a timezone selector at the top-right of the page.
- If you don’t select a time within 48 hours, a member of the team will reach out with a few suggested windows.

Suggested 30-minute agenda:
- 10 min: your goals + constraints
- 15 min: demo focused on inference latency/cost controls and dedicated capacity options
- 5 min: next steps (POC / pricing / security checklist)

Attached: brief intake form to share your use case (intake-form.pdf) — filling it out ahead of the call helps us tailor the demo.

If you prefer, reply here with preferred days/times (include timezone) and I’ll confirm.

Best,
Logan Wright
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
Note: This is an outreach template sent after a self-serve signup. If you already booked a time via the calendar link, ignore this message.

Also, we have a short procurement intake — I can loop in our ops contact if you need any compliance pre-reads.

Best,
